goal: Operationally characterize the installed Freebuff CLI as a candidate executor for Apex parallel delegated tasks and inventory its native agent and skill extensibility surfaces.
scope: Installed Freebuff CLI and cached runtime binary
native CLI/TUI help, model/provider picker, agent controls, and cwd behavior
bounded attempts to observe delegation, concurrency, identity, isolation, failure containment, aggregation, retry/rework, cancellation, dependencies, and per-task model/provider assignment
evidence report and control-plane suitability classification
out_of_scope: Freebuff ownership of backlog, scheduling, authority, verification, or semantic success
secret inspection, credential persistence, or repository mutation
architecture_constraints: executors remain workers and never canonical backlog or scheduler authority
Apex Core remains authority and verification owner
no secrets in evidence, logs, backlog, or Passport
advertised UI/source surfaces must be separated from operational proof
unsupported or incomplete capabilities remain NOT_PROVEN
acceptance_criteria: Freebuff version and public CLI surface are recorded
native agent and skill/extension surfaces are inventoried with evidence boundaries
native delegation is executed or classified NOT_PROVEN
true concurrent execution and distinct worker/session identity are directly evidenced or classified NOT_PROVEN
workspace/state isolation, failure containment, and result aggregation are tested or classified
retry/rework and cancellation are tested or classified
dependency sequencing and per-task model/provider assignment are tested or classified
Freebuff suitability for Apex Control Plane integration is classified without permanent selection
validation: bounded Freebuff TUI launch with --cwd in a disposable non-repository directory
canonical Python tests and documentation validation
